title: Undergraduate & Graduate Positions EOI (Sunshine Coast regional)
content_text: Expression of interest for Undergraduate and Graduate positions at Georgiou (part of STRABAG), Sunshine Coast regional. Tertiary qualifications in Civil Engineering, Environmental Science, HSEQ, Construction Management or related. Passion for civil construction. Develop technical skills across Engineering, Project Management and Tendering. Completes competencies in Graduate Development Program. Handbook available at georgiou.com.au. Apply via Georgiou careers / EOI listing.
apply_instructions: EOI via Georgiou careers cadet-graduate programs and advertised Sunshine Coast EOI channels
